Islam beats Ian Gary in a decision. 

#iangarybrasil #is
good: Compelling hook with immediate dynamic action (the lift stops scrolls)
Strong narrative progression: action → intensity → victory celebration with emotional peak
High share rate (1.14%) shows genuine shareability among MMA audience
Solid watch-through (7.0s avg) indicates strong content pacing
bad: Very low save rate (0.07%): Instagram prioritizes saves, this is the primary algorithmic bottleneck
Generic caption lacks emotional hook or CTA (no 'tag someone', question, or engagement ask)
Hook frame cluttered with sponsor logos and overlapping text reducing visual clarity
reels.top_tip: Increase saves by adding a super-compelling moment in first 0.5s (slow-motion strike, shocked reaction) with minimal UI overlay, plus a caption CTA ('who do you think won?', 'tag someone', 'rate this takedown')

reels.caption:
Mackenzie Dern vence em decisao x Gillisn Robertson. UFC 330
Mackenzie wins over a decision x Gillian Robertson 

#savag
good: Strong visual hook: intense cage fighting action is inherently scroll-stopping
Color contrast: pink/red shorts pop against blue mat and cage, making the subject unmissable
Clear narrative arc: progression from fight to victory celebration creates story momentum
Professional production: UFC branding, graphics, and dual-frame layout show high quality
bad: No text overlay on hook frame: viewers see action but don't know it's a title fight or the outcome until much later
Caption not displayed as on-screen text: valuable context (championship decision, fighter names) buried in caption instead of overlaid
Victory celebration delayed: the most engaging frame (Dern with belt) should anchor the hook, not appear at 2:42
Early drop-off at 9.6s average watch time: suggests viewers don't get hooked enough to stay through the full reel
reels.top_tip: Add on-screen text to the hook frame immediately ('CHAMPIONSHIP DECISION' / 'DERN WINS') and front-load the victory celebration visual—put the belt-holding moment in the first 2 seconds to hook viewers who otherwise see it as generic fight content
